recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed unless a future CDS/Questionnaire decision explicitly reintroduces a different option-level semantic extension.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive CDS issue for FHIR-core Questionnaire requesting removal of the cqf-optioncode extension because it was incomprehensible and appeared to duplicate Questionnaire.code; the approved resolution was to remove it as suggested.
initial_application: The Jira comment points to GH#54dcccf677, and commit 54dcccf677457b19171bbca3c632e084905c39e9 is titled "GF#17822: Removed cqf-optionCode extension." That commit removed the optionCode row from source/clinicalreasoning-module.html and changed the clinical reasoning extension spreadsheet so the extension was no longer emitted. The original optionCode extension traces back to commit 98c5119546d6e84950825099fdb0814fb8d7508c for FHIR-12485/GF#12485.
additional_context: Current source/fhir.ini keeps questionnaire as an active resource and clinicalreasoning-extensions as an active profile spreadsheet. Current Questionnaire.code remains a 0..* Coding element for the overall questionnaire. Searches of current core source and the read-only FHIR Extension Pack found no cqf-optioncode, optionCode, or StructureDefinition-cqf-optioncode definition/reference outside excluded historical/generated data. Zulip context supports the removal, and Confluence searches found no conflicting record.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the approved removal is already reflected in current build-scope source and no current Extension Pack artifact needs a corresponding change.
